gen-gf-underdog-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Underdog draws every curve at a single weight, its c swung open like a horseshoe, loud and sure of itself. Zen Kaku Gothic New then reads smoothly, open-mouthed curves with no hairlines.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Maru Gothic is a sans that reads like following one thread. Underdog earns its place big and brief, where its horseshoe c and unvarying curves can command attention.
gen-gf-underdog-ibm-plex-sans: A horseshoe-wide c and curves that never thin give Underdog its loud, expressive swagger at the top. IBM Plex Sans stays approachable, with wide channels leading into every bowl.
gen-gf-underdog-zilla-slab: Expressive to the bone, Underdog never shifts weight along a curve, and its c swings open like a horseshoe. Zilla Slab, a sturdy slab-serif, keeps text moving with broad openings on every bowl-ended curve.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-amulya: Amulya is a modern sans-serif with generous gaps in its curves and a lowercase of moderate height. Unica One shouts through tall, wire-bent s curves; Amulya simply talks.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-chillax: Casual and relaxed, Chillax loops its sans-serif lines like spaghetti. Unica One commands with an oversized lowercase eye and unvarying strokes, while Chillax leaves its pen-lifted loops unfinished.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-plein: Reliable and clean, Plein gives each round letter a clear channel to breathe through. And Unica One does the commanding, its curves full of daylight, where sans-serif Plein just carries the text.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-roundo: Roundo is a geometric sans-serif whose n has an arch matching its stem, and whose small counters never clog. Unica One takes the loud lead, and Roundo quietly follows.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-spline-sans: Unica One's very large lowercase eye, with daylight showing inside every curve, gives it a commanding look. Spline Sans moves smoothly, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, clean and dependable. Unica One earns its keep big and brief, where its commanding lowercase and daylight-filled curves can be seen.
